words.example: Once she accepts, HR can initiate the review of her background.
words.exampleZh: 她一接受录用，人力资源就可以启动背景审查。

words.example: On the first of June we launch the new screen that calls the queue.
words.exampleZh: 六月一日我们推出用来叫号的新屏幕。

words.example: Until headcount is confirmed, we should pause any further hiring.
words.exampleZh: 编制确认之前，我们应暂停继续招聘。

words.example: Orientation can resume the morning our trainer is back in the office.
words.exampleZh: 培训师回到办公室的那天上午，入职培训可以恢复进行。

words.example: Security can suspend a badge that is still missing at closing time.
words.exampleZh: 到关门时还没归还的工牌，安保可以中止使用。

words.example: Speed mismatch between the phone and the switch port made calls choppy.
words.exampleZh: 电话和交换机端口速率不匹配，通话就变得断断续续。

words.example: CRC error counters climbed on the fiber to building C after the storm.
words.exampleZh: 暴风雨之后，通往 C 座那根光纤上的校验错误计数一直在涨。

words.example: A broadcast storm in the lobby VLAN slowed badge readers to a crawl.
words.exampleZh: 大厅 VLAN 里的广播风暴把门禁读卡器拖得几乎没反应。

words.example: A loop between two ward switches flooded every port with broadcasts.
words.exampleZh: 两台病区交换机之间的环路把每个端口都灌满了广播。

words.example: Spanning tree blocked the extra link and stopped the clinic loop.
words.exampleZh: 生成树堵住了多余的那条链路，门诊的环路就停了。
